en: Welcome to the refuge, $n. Some come here with a purpose, others found their way here by accident... But everyone here seems to have a unique story to tell.
Eranikus, Tyrant of the Dream, has entered our world.
Astor? Taken your bloody time getting here, so let's not waste any time, shall we?
That wasn't very helpful. Let me check the other one.
The Timberlings have made it too difficult for the fishermen to catch anything around Dolanaar.  You best look for someone to train you in Darnassus.
The Goddess has granted me wisdom, stranger. If it is her will, I shall pass it on to you.
So, you have found me. I suppose that you have come to learn of suppression and control.$B$BI will teach you much more than that... you will also learn of sacrifice.$B$B<Daio grins.>
The shadow of the Scourge yet remains on this land, fools! You will never prevail!

Greed has led you back to me.$B$B<Mathredis laughs.>$B$BA wise Draenei once told me that it - greed - is the single quality that all of the races on this world share. I would have to agree.$B$BHave you collected the components listed within the libram?
%s's laughter echoes through the halls of Blackwing.

Sildinair has trained many of the Sentinels who guard our beloved city.  I am certain she can make a warrior out of the likes of you.  Seek her out at the Warrior's Terrace near the entrance to our city.
The rage of Ishamuhale runs through you, $n.
If you have the aptitude for the $cic arts, I can train you.
%s waves to $n
The first stage is over.  Big Will... come on down!
What can I do for you $c?
It's Proudmoore! Get out of here!
I come to raze your bases, Frost Wolf clan. Ivus punishes you for your treachery!
Please clean yourself before handling our tomes.

The waters of Westfall are where you must search, due west-northwest of where the Gold Coast Quarry meets with the shore.  An anchor shows where a boat has sunk beyond it, deep within the water.  The underwater pressure is fierce here; swimming too far will crush even the mightiest swimmer from fatigue.  $B$BLook for a natural formation to aid you, $n - a bubbly fissure is near here, offering deep-water swimmers a chance for renewed breath.
Your talent is beyond my own, friend. Speak with Tarn here; his knowledge of leather is much greater than mine. I'm sure he would welcome another student.
No!  Leave us!  We must not fail our task!
Krathok, I was once a weaponsmith and wish to instead learn the ways of the armorsmith. Will you train me?
I have what you need, $c.
I tire of this nonsense! Prepare to die, $r!
I would speak for my brother joining the order, potentially risking the safety of the order.  I could help him with the order's regimens, and I'd have faith in his ability to adapt and learn.
Scarlet Monastery lies in the hills northeast of Tirisfal Glades.

Hi $n!  Thanks for all the help you've given me!  Right now I don't need anything, but who knows what the future will bring?$B$BEnjoy yourself, and remember to tell your friends about the Darkmoon Faire!
Oh! I almost forgot! I slipped you a set of thieven' tools. You'll need those where you're going.
Come! Come to your deaths--if you dare!
Death to Frostwolf!
Ah, so that is how they pushed the Dark Iron to the lower parts of the Spire.
Tharnariun, I have lost the trap. Could you please give me another?
Betina, I'd like a replacement Seal of the Dawn please!
Become a mentor for one of our orphans during the Week of the Wardens!  For the Horde!
Do you hate me, my love? That I was forced to destroy your living form, that your spirit be released from unhappy bondage.
So few make it this far, even fewer make it past. Do not become a statistic, $N.
Take a look around, $n. Perhaps you will find something that I have missed.

When you give love tokens to townsfolk, you'll receive different gifts in return.  Some of those you'll want to keep and use, but others can be bundled together and given to your favorite hero!  Visit Kwee Q. Peddlefeet to turn them in.$B$BKwee can be found near Bolvar, Magni, or Tyrande.
You're better at this gig than I am! You want someone with even more experience than I've got. That'd be Ainethil, a night elf lady who lives in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus.
Good day to you both. I would speak to Lord Lescovar.
